tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, erythrocytosis, and elevated hematocrit. There are mild abnormalities in white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia, low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages). Mild metabolic acidosis is suggested by low CO₂ and high chloride. Liver and renal function are largely normal, with isolated mild elevation of alkaline phosphatase. No evidence of COVID-19 infection. Findings may suggest a respiratory disorder with possible compensatory erythrocytosis; clinical correlation is recommended.
